title: Night Safety
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: An app I never installed started sending me rules.
first_visual: A lock screen in a dark room: notification NIGHT SAFETY, Rule 1.

beats.visual: Lock screen: NIGHT SAFETY: Rule 1: Don't reply to messages from yourself.
beats.vo: An app I never installed started sending me rules.
Then a message. From my own number.

beats.visual: Jun's phone lights itself on the bed; he slaps it face down.
beats.vo: Rule two: if the screen lights itself, cover it.

beats.visual: Jun picks it up; the front camera has opened; he flips it away.
beats.vo: Three: no front camera after two.

beats.visual: Jun, annoyed, holds the icon down.
beats.vo: Creepy app. I held the icon.

beats.visual: 'Rule 4: Don't uninstall me.' He taps Remove: 'Night Safety removed. You're on your own.'
Notification flood from 'Jun (you)': finally / it's quiet now / turn round.
beats.vo: It wasn't the threat. It was the wall.

beats.visual: Key moment: the front camera view: Jun, and behind him his own face, a head taller, smiling.

ending: The front camera opens itself: Jun, and behind him his own face smiling, a head taller.

originality_review: Original. The 'protective app' inversion is ours. It uses generic UI, no real app branding. A doppelganger ending is common, so the score is lowered; the mechanism makes it distinct.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: An unknown 'Night Safety' app sends Jun rules. He finds it creepy and uninstalls it. The app wasn't the threat. It was blocking the messages from 'himself'.

hooks.line: An app I never installed started sending me rules.
hooks.first_visual: A lock screen in a dark room: notification NIGHT SAFETY, Rule 1.

hooks.line: Rule one: don't reply to messages from yourself.
hooks.first_visual: A message thread from the user's own name.

hooks.line: My screen lit up on its own. Rule two: cover it.
hooks.first_visual: A phone lighting itself on a bed; a hand slapping it face down.

hooks.line: Creepy app. So I uninstalled it.
hooks.first_visual: A thumb holding an app icon, 'Remove?'

hooks.line: Forty messages from me. All at once.

conflict: Jun's distrust of an intrusive app.
escalation: A message from his own number, a self-lit screen, the front camera, then 'Don't uninstall me.'
reveal: After uninstalling, a flood of messages from 'Jun (you)': 'finally', 'it's quiet now', 'turn round'.
